_help: The inventory window (official MapleStory art, UIInventory.img). x/y = the small window top-left in 1366x768 game pixels. w/h = the small window size (the art is 242x593). xExpanded/yExpanded/wExpanded/hExpanded = the wide window the + button opens (the art is 800x546). wide = 1 starts the wide window (0 = the small one). The rest is window-local, measured on the official art: titleH = the drag strip at the top. gridX/gridY = the grid container's top-left; cellSize/cellPitch = the official slot square and pitch (UIInventory.img pos: slot_pos 28,101, slot_width/height 42, slot_space 4); pageCols/pageGapX = the WZ slot_col 4 and page_space_x 2 (the wide grid is four pages of four columns, with 2px more between pages); rows = the visible rows (8). cols/colsWide = the columns of the small and wide window. the item icon is centered in the 42×42 cell; countItemX/countItemY/countItemW/countItemH = the count object's box inside its cell (pos item_count_pos 0,28; the 8x11 ItemNo digits are 11 tall). tabX/tabY = the first tab, tabW/tabH = the tab box, tabStep/tabWideW/tabWideStep = the tab row of the small and the wide window. countX/countY/countW/countH = the used/total pill in the small window (the official art holds only the slash; the numbers sit on each side), countWideX/countWideY/countWideW/countWideH = the same in the wide window; countUsedX/countTotalX and countUsedWideX/countTotalWideX = the right edge of each number, from the WZ slotNum0/slotNum1 vectors (the total is 3 px left of the vector to sit closer to the slash), countNumH/countNumY = the digit height and their bottom, countGap = the gap between the used and total boxes. plusX/plusY/plusW/plusH = the + button (small window), minusX/minusY/minusW/minusH = the - button (wide window), closeX/closeY/closeW/closeH = the X, closeWideX = the X in the wide window. sortX/sortY/sortW/sortH = the sort button (small), sortWideX/sortWideY/sortWideW/sortWideH = the sort button (wide). coinX/coinY = the meso coin, mesoX/mesoY = the meso number (the number's right end), mesoWideX/mesoWideY = the same in the wide window. Keys may be omitted (keeps the default). tipTextW = the width the description wraps at (its inner layout comes from panel-stat.json: the detail pane of the stat window).
